purpose: Seasonal costume concepts for review; not animation sprite sheets

concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Sobrita seasonal character costume concept, one standalone full-body transparent PNG.
Primary request: Dress the existing Michi cat in a warm, festive Día de Muertos marigold floral adornment. This is a costume concept for the exact established character, not a redesign.
Input images: Image 1 (/Users/jaewook/dev_app/sobra_app/design/characters/michi/base-v2.png) is the identity and pose edit target. Image 2 (/Users/jaewook/dev_app/sobra_app/assets/characters/michi/idle-8.png) is supporting in-app rendering reference only; it is a strip of repeated animation frames, and you must output only ONE cat.
Subject and changes: Keep the original sitting full-body silhouette and expression. Add a carefully arranged cempasúchil flower crown of bright golden-orange Mexican marigolds, with two small magenta accent blossoms and a few deep green leaves. Nestle the crown between and around the ears, keeping the upright ear, folded ear, and three forehead stripes readable. Add a small matching marigold corsage to one side of the existing teal collar, leaving the square gold tag entirely visible. The face remains the original Michi face.
Identity invariants: navy-blue fluffy tabby kitten, warm amber eyes, pink nose, cream muzzle and chest and paws, three cream forehead stripes, one tall upright ear at viewer left and one folded ear at viewer right with tiny cream star marking, striped curled tail with cream tip, teal collar with square gold tag. Preserve these features, body proportions, head size, palette and original facial identity.
Style/medium: match the reference's richly shaded detailed pixel-art game mascot, crisp stepped pixel contours, coherent pixel scale, carefully clustered pixels, warm soft shading. The flowers must use the same pixel-art rendering and outline weight as the cat.
Composition: exactly one large centered seated cat, all ears/flowers/paws/tail entirely visible, square canvas with about 12 percent breathing room. Truly transparent alpha background, no scene or cast shadow.
Mood: affectionate, joyful, warm Día de Muertos floral celebration.
Avoid: text, labels, logos, frames, contact sheets, duplicated characters, Halloween pumpkins, horror, skeleton face paint, skull masks, hats covering the ears, changes to the character's face, extra limbs, smooth vector art, 3D plastic render, checkerboard baked into background.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Sobrita seasonal character costume concept, one standalone full-body transparent PNG.
Primary request: Put the exact established Sobrita Poodle dog in an adorable Halloween pumpkin outfit, preserving its original character identity.
Input images: Image 1 (/Users/jaewook/dev_app/sobra_app/assets/characters/poodle/idle-8.png) is the identity edit target; it is an 8-frame strip of the SAME dog, and you must output only ONE dog, using the relaxed forward-facing seated pose of its first frame. Image 2 (/Users/jaewook/dev_app/sobra_app/design/characters/sobra-poodle-concept-v1.png) is supporting character/style reference only; do not reproduce the reference board or any text.
Subject and changes: A softly padded round orange pumpkin romper around the torso, with readable broad pumpkin ribs and a friendly small dark jack-o-lantern smile on the front. A simple deep green leaf-shaped neckline fits beneath the original teal collar so the original square gold tag remains visible. A small tilted pumpkin-top cap with a short green stem sits on top of the curly forelock without hiding its characteristic curls, face, or floppy ears. Its four cream-tipped paws and little round fluffy tail remain visible through costume openings. Costume clearly reads as a wearable pumpkin garment with the original dog inside.
Identity invariants: warm apricot/caramel curly poodle, huge fluffy rounded topknot, two long floppy curly ears, large golden amber eyes, small black nose, cream muzzle and cream paw tips, dark outline, original teal collar and square gold tag, same head/body proportions and lovable forward-facing seated pose. Keep original fur colors; the costume is a distinct deeper orange.
Style/medium: match the actual app reference's detailed pixel-art pet with crisp stepped pixel contours, coherent pixel scale, clustered curly fur, dark thin outline and warm shaded forms. Pumpkin clothing must be pixel art consistent with the dog.
Composition: exactly one large centered seated poodle, all cap/ears/paws/tail entirely visible, square canvas with about 12 percent breathing room. Truly transparent alpha background, no scene or cast shadow.
Mood: cozy, playful, endearing Halloween.
Avoid: text, labels, logos, frames, contact sheets, duplicated dogs, extra props, extra limbs, leaf collar hiding gold tag, hood covering head or ears, frightening face, skeletons, realistic photography, smooth vector art, 3D plastic render, checkerboard baked into background.
